findings.title: An unknown discount code raises KeyError
findings.body: `DISCOUNTS[code]` raises `KeyError` for any code that is not in the table, so a mistyped code becomes a server error instead of a validation error. Look it up with `DISCOUNTS.get(code)` and reject unknown codes explicitly.

findings.title: Every page returns one order too many
findings.body: The slice ends at `start + size + 1`, so each page holds `size + 1` orders and the last order of one page is repeated as the first of the next. Use `orders[start : start + size]`.

findings.title: round() on a Decimal rounds half to even
findings.body: `round(total, 2)` uses the context's ROUND_HALF_EVEN, which may not be the rounding the business expects for money. Quantize with an explicit rounding mode.

findings.title: No test for an unknown code or for pagination
findings.body: The new test covers only the happy path of a known code. Add cases for an unknown code and for `page()` boundaries, which would have caught both bugs above.
